about: Grimsby is a town on the Niagara Escarpment and Lake Ontario shore between Hamilton and St. Catharines. It sits in Niagara’s tender-fruit and wine belt, with a historic downtown below the escarpment brow and beaches along the lake. The Bruce Trail and orchard country are close at hand. About 29,000 people live in Grimsby.
